description: Post-review fixes: add clipboard fallback for insecure contexts, change tag separators to comma-separated format, and use semantic <article> elements instead of <div> for accordion items.
steps: Add a fallbackCopy helper function using document.execCommand('copy') with a textarea element
Update copyTitle, copyArticle, and copyTags to try navigator.clipboard first with .catch() fallback to the textarea approach
Change all 21 data-tags attributes from space-separated (#Word1 #Word2) to comma+space separated (#Word1, #Word2, #Word3)
Update JS querySelectorAll('.accordion-item') references (should still work with class selector regardless of element type)
acceptance_criteria: fallbackCopy function exists using textarea + execCommand('copy')
All 3 copy functions have .catch() handlers that call fallbackCopy
All 21 data-tags attributes use comma+space as separator between tags
All 21 accordion items use <article> element instead of <div>
JavaScript still functions correctly with <article> elements
verification: Run: grep -c 'fallbackCopy' satuyangterpenting.wordpress.com.html - should be >= 4 (1 definition + 3 calls)
Run: grep 'data-tags' satuyangterpenting.wordpress.com.html | grep -c ', #' - should be 21
Run: grep -c '<article class="accordion-item">' satuyangterpenting.wordpress.com.html - should be 21
Run: grep -c '<div class="accordion-item">' satuyangterpenting.wordpress.com.html - should be 0
